review_basis: Single FAO-1952 row: 'Ethiopia' population 1937, reported value 15,000 (thousand people = 15M). The candidate AOI-1936-1941 wiki explicitly documents this exact failure mode: sources labeling 1936-1941 Horn-of-Africa data 'Ethiopia' sometimes mean the full Italian East Africa aggregate (~1.7M km2: Ethiopia+Eritrea+Italian Somaliland), not occupied-Ethiopia-alone (~1M km2), and gives a magnitude test (>1.5x pre-1936 ETH series => route to AOI). No pre-1936 population series exists in this source/bundle to run that test directly, so I checked external population estimates: contemporary sources put Italian East Africa's total population at ~12.1M (1939) versus Ethiopia-alone (Ethiopia Governorate) at ~9.45M. FAO's reported 15M is closer in order of magnitude to the AOI aggregate (ratio 1.24x) than to Ethiopia alone (ratio 1.59x), though it overshoots both slightly, consistent with typical inflation in Italian-era colonial population estimates of this period. The bundle's own source_convention (this FAO population series reads ~1/3 of true total for industrialized economies like Yugoslavia/USA/Germany/Japan/USSR) likely does NOT transfer cleanly to Ethiopia, an overwhelmingly agrarian society where agricultural population approx. total population -- so I did not apply a 3x deflation, which would have implied an implausible ~45M total. Given (a) the deterministic route was an explicit, pre-vetted alias built for exactly this label+year pattern, (b) the wiki's own stated purpose is to catch 'Ethiopia' labels covering full AOI scope in 1936-1941, and (c) the external magnitude comparison favors AOI over ETH-alone, I confirm the AOI-1936-1941 routing, though as a best-available call given the single data point (n=1) and the inherent unreliability of 1930s Horn-of-Africa population statistics.

Pulling the neighboring IIA assertions for the "ethiopia" label shows coffee, green production of 19,800 tonnes (1932, routed to ETH-1907-1936), 16,300 tonnes (1938, this assertion, routed to AOI-1936-1941), and 17,000 tonnes (1945, routed to ETH-1907-1952) — a smooth, essentially flat series with no ~70% step-up. Since the source's actual reporting territory (Ethiopian highlands coffee production) is demonstrably narrower than AOI's full 1.7M km2 territory, and no existing polity captures the narrower occupied-Ethiopia-proper scope for this exact span, I recommend a new dedicated polity rather than confirming or rerouting to a territorially wrong candidate.
